meta.name: elevenlabs-dubbing
meta.description: ElevenLabs automatic dubbing - translate and dub audio/video into 29 languages while preserving speaker voice via inference.sh CLI. Capabilities: auto speaker detection, voice-preserving translation, video dubbing, audio localization. Use for: content localization, video translation, multilingual content, international distribution. Triggers: dubbing, dub video, translate audio, video translation, audio translation, localize content, elevenlabs dubbing, eleven labs dub, multilingual dub, voice translation, auto dub, language dub, content localization

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将音频视频翻译并配音成29种语言，保留原声
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将视频或音频内容翻译成多种语言并保留原声。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行将音频或视频文件翻译并配音成 29 种语言，同时保留原说话人的声音特征。
howto.when: 当你要求配音、翻译音频或视频、本地化内容，或提到“elevenlabs dubbing”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个英文视频配音成西班牙语。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具处理视频链接。

say.text: 把这个播客音频翻译成法语并配音。
say.note: Claude 会处理音频文件并输出配音结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can translate and dub audio or video files into 29 languages via command line, preserving the original speaker's voice characteristics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for dubbing, audio/video translation, content localization, or mention keywords like "elevenlabs dubbing".

say_en.text: Dub this English video to Spanish.
say_en.note: Claude will process the video link.

say_en.text: Translate and dub this podcast audio to French.
say_en.note: Claude will handle the audio file.
